notes: Synthetic linear SEM chain for NOTEARS continuous discovery. Tolerance RequiredDirectedEdges: every true edge must appear oriented correctly; at most max_false_positive_edges extras. Not an Exact black-box pin against an upstream NOTEARS oracle (non-convex / threshold-sensitive).

historical_reference.note: Frozen synthetic SEM; regeneration refreshes data.csv only — expected edges are the SCM ground truth, not an external solver dump.

evidence_proposition: On an 800-row linear chain x0 -> x1 -> x2 with deterministic uniform-like noise, standardised NOTEARS at lambda 0.05 and threshold 0.2 returns every true edge correctly oriented with at most the declared number of extra edges.
limitations: Recovery of the generating edges by a non-convex, threshold-sensitive optimiser on one dataset: the true edges are the construction of the data, but no solver value is derived, the orientation after standardisation is not guaranteed by theory, and no reference solver is compared. Not a derived numerical truth. No calibration.

oracle.origin: Current review of retained local contract inputs and their exact executing consumer; this record asserts no external generator or independent numerical origin.
